target.body:
The Access evidence emitter accepted complete compressed ZIP receipts up to 4 MiB, exceeding Accepted ADR 0001 VAL-07's 2 MiB log limit. This closes the implementation gap reported as **C0-E1 Low** in #136: permit `<= 2,097,152` finalized ZIP bytes and explicitly refuse larger bundles before any receipt stdout, with guidance to the uploaded GitHub Actions artifact.

The production diff is a named limit constant and the existing post-ZIP check/diagnostic. BEGIN/DATA/END, SHA-256, index/binding contracts, member selection and artifact upload remain intact. No workflow change is needed: both emitter and subsequent artifact upload already use `if: always()`. The regression checks their ordering, upload action/name/paths and byte-identical upload inputs after overflow. This is configuration/input preservation evidence, not a claimed new hosted overflow-and-download experiment.

### Boundary and contract evidence

The tests run the implemented `main()` path on **real complete DEFLATED ZIPs**, adjusting only a legal ZIP comment to produce deterministic exact final byte lengths; they do not equate input length with compressed size or mock `len`.

| Complete compressed ZIP bytes | Before | Corrected |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2,097,151 | success | success |
| 2,097,152 | success | success |
| 2,097,153 | incorrect success | exit 1, zero stdout |
| 2,323,560 (audit counterexample size) | incorrect success | exit 1, zero stdout |

A 53,803-byte receipt whose expanded members exceed 2 MiB succeeds, proving the cap applies to compressed bytes. Successful bundles strictly decode with matching BEGIN/END, length/SHA-256, member index lengths/hashes and binding. An unmocked oversized CLI run exits 1, keeps source artifacts unchanged, emits no stdout and gives the artifact fallback diagnostic.

- Historical source replay: **7 tests / 3 expected failures, exit 1**.
- Corrected source replay: **7 passed, exit 0**.
- Related local pytest (emitter + CI plan/profile/journal/runtime/policy units + CI execution integration): **280 passed, 57 subtests passed, zero skips/failures/errors, exit 0**. Exact collection/start/JUnit identities reconcile; all phases and session exit pass.
- Repository Ruff lint and format, verifier lint/format, SQLite policy detector and report validation: **pass, exit 0**.
- Python **3.12.14**, actual built-in SQLite **3.53.1**; full executable/platform/source identity, commands, exits, raw logs, compressed JUnit/journal and changed-file hashes are saved in [the evidence report](docs/implementation/evidence/c0-e1-receipt-limit-20261023/README.md). No SQLite component download/build/install/swap or matrix.

### Exact publication

- Base: `review/c0-hosted-runtime-audit-20261022` (#136).
- Base HEAD: `8ede5f8f3f525baf90ad8c9b4f3f0729c19a7b82`.
- Base tree: `65e9311819ec354cbc3d6ede1cbc10ebd5c2ced9`.
- Feature branch: `fix/c0-e1-receipt-limit-20261023`.
- Feature HEAD: `3e2609baa07a9e92c8f2dc4dd1608f311021a1cb`.
- Feature tree: `43f0c017d5f922f7e1caf7e4a1605ec4ae7ace1c`.
- Sole commit parent is the frozen #136 HEAD. Executed local source/test hashes exactly match this publication; raw records disclose the working-tree overlay used during development.

### Limits and review status

C0-E1 has a code correction and executable closure evidence; independent reviewer acceptance remains pending. Historical 79 non-success nodes (59 failures + 20 setup errors) are not claimed resolved or reclassified. Full product pytest, Access/I4/I5 runs, wheel/sdist checks and release qualification were not rerun for this limit-only change. Hosted development checks will be reported separately and do not mean complete release acceptance.

Changes are restricted to `scripts/emit_ci_evidence.py`, related unit tests and new verification evidence. Accepted ADRs, historical logs/ZIPs/audits, product code/DDL/UDF/safety tests and existing workflows are unchanged. No existing PR branch update, rebase/force-push, merge, deployment or release.

### Verified hosted development result

[Run 39887549016, attempt 1](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/actions/runs/39887549016) **passed** both `offline` and `sqlite-policy`. Actual hosted steps completed planning/report validation, repository lint/format, SQLite capabilities/doctor and composed-schema/guard checks. Product pytest and packaging steps were unselected; manifest status is `development_checks_passed`, `full_acceptance=false`, **0 product pytest IDs executed**.

The actual test merge `6d649500319f404da210a92151a88f37bbd60fc2` has parents frozen base + this feature HEAD and the same feature tree `43f0c017d5f922f7e1caf7e4a1605ec4ae7ace1c`. The live REST run-log ZIP was retrieved; its 71,313-byte in-log receipt has SHA-256 `ecd164beb7edfed98a97c342684590ae926b405630c21e88aaa2bca2945b52bb`. BEGIN/DATA/END, strict base64, length/hash, all 21 indexed payload members, manifest and run/attempt/feature/merge/tree binding were verified.

GitHub confirms uploaded artifact `ci-profile-39887549016-1` (ID `12472429473`, 71,124 bytes, not expired). Direct artifact download was attempted once and denied by the cloud blob endpoint with **Forbidden (403)**; no successful artifact download is claimed. The independently verified job-log receipt supplied the hosted evidence. This is the ordinary tests workflow's receipt; the Access overflow/upload path was verified locally/configurationally as described above. Publication is complete; independent reviewer acceptance remains pending.
